source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U15: Distinguish transferred proceedings, existing decrees and institutional protections

payload.title: Transfer the legal record, not just the case label
payload.core_explanation_md:
The statutory transfer provision concerns proceedings that satisfy its conditions at Tribunal establishment, with the stated exceptions; it is not a command to move every pending appeal. The records and stage already reached remain important. The separate route for an existing unexecuted decree seeks a recovery certificate on that decree rather than assuming that all original liability questions must be retried.

The framework also identifies the protected institutional officers, their public-function status, good-faith protection and rulemaking powers. Overriding and additional-remedy clauses need to be read together with applicable insolvency law. The source contradictory case-overruling summary is preserved for review rather than taught as a settled current priority rule.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every pending appeal automatically transfer under the general suit-transfer rule?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The stated exceptions and actual proceeding must be checked.

payload.stem_md: A migration list includes all pending appeals without checking the statutory exception. Which correction is required?

options.text_md: Transfer every item solely because the claimant is a bank
options.explanation_md: The proceeding type and conditions still matter.

options.text_md: Classify each proceeding and apply the stated transfer conditions and exceptions
options.explanation_md: The general rule does not eliminate its exceptions.

options.text_md: Discard the original records after transfer
options.explanation_md: The record and stage are needed for lawful continuation.

options.text_md: Treat transfer as satisfaction of every decree
options.explanation_md: Transfer and payment are different events.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The general rule does not eliminate its exceptions.

payload.stem_md: An unexecuted qualifying civil decree is taken to the Tribunal under the described certificate route. What is the central distinction?

options.text_md: The old decree necessarily becomes void merely from the application
options.explanation_md: The certificate route recognises the decree rather than proving it void.

options.text_md: A new applicant can privately choose a different decretal amount
Every fact must automatically be tried again as a fresh loan suit
options.explanation_md: The source describes a certificate based on the existing decree.

options.text_md: Execution through the statutory certificate route differs from a fresh merits trial
options.explanation_md: Identify the existing decree and applicable recovery mechanism.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Identify the existing decree and applicable recovery mechanism.
